ideas.title: Investigating Child Care Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the child care providers receiving funding from the state program and the allegations of fraud
questions: How many providers are being investigated?
What is the total amount of funding involved?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a significant pattern of fraud and abuse of state funding. By following the money and examining public records, we can shed light on the extent of the problem and hold those responsible accountable.
